questions.stem: In a histogram, the class with interval width $10$ has a frequency of $24$. Work out the frequency density for this class.
markscheme: M1: uses frequency density = frequency ÷ class width
questions.modelAnswer: Frequency density is frequency divided by class width: $24 \div 10 = 2.4$. The bar height is $2.4$.

questions.stem: In a right-angled triangle, the side opposite an angle $\theta$ has length $5$ cm and the side adjacent to $\theta$ has length $12$ cm. Work out the length of the hypotenuse, and give $\sin \theta$ as a fraction.
questions.modelAnswer: The hypotenuse is $\sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13$ cm. Sine is opposite over hypotenuse, so $\sin \theta = \dfrac{5}{13}$.

questions.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = 3x - 5$. Work out $f(4)$, and find the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$.
questions.modelAnswer: $f(4) = 3 \times 4 - 5 = 7$. For the inverse, start with $y = 3x - 5$ and solve for $x$: $x = \dfrac{y + 5}{3}$, so $f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{x + 5}{3}$. Check: $f^{-1}(7) = \dfrac{7+5}{3} = 4$, which undoes $f(4) = 7$ as expected.

questions.stem: Point A has position vector $\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix}$ and point B has position vector $\begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix}$. Find the vector $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and work out its magnitude, giving your answer in its simplest surd form.
markscheme: A1: magnitude $= \sqrt{72} = 6\sqrt{2}$ (accept $\approx 8.49$ with surd form seen)

questions.stem: A triangle has two sides of lengths $8$ cm and $10$ cm, and the angle between these two sides is $30^\circ$. Work out the area of the triangle.
markscheme: M1: states or uses area $= \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$

questions.stem: Points A, B and C lie on a circle with centre O, and C lies on the major arc AB. The angle $\widehat{AOB} = 118^\circ$. (a) Work out the angle $\widehat{ACB}$. (b) The segments OA and OC are drawn. Work out the angle $\widehat{OAC}$.
markscheme: M1: angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference, used for $\widehat{ACB}$
questions.modelAnswer: (a) The angle at the circumference is half the angle at the centre standing on the same arc AB, so $\widehat{ACB} = 118^\circ \div 2 = 59^\circ$. (b) OA and OC are both radii, so triangle OAC is isosceles and the two base angles are equal: $\widehat{OAC} = \widehat{OCA} = (180^\circ - 118^\circ) \div 2 = 31^\circ$.

questions.stem: The times, in minutes, that students spent reading one evening are shown in a histogram. The bar for the class $0 < t \le 20$ has height $0.4$, the bar for the class $20 < t \le 50$ has height $0.6$, and the bar for the class $50 < t \le 90$ has height $0.25$. Work out the total number of students in the group.
markscheme: M1: frequency = bar height × class width, applied to each class
A1: two of the three frequencies $8$, $18$ and $10$ seen
questions.modelAnswer: Frequency equals height times width for each bar. Class $0 < t \le 20$: width $20$, frequency $0.4 \times 20 = 8$. Class $20 < t \le 50$: width $30$, frequency $0.6 \times 30 = 18$. Class $50 < t \le 90$: width $40$, frequency $0.25 \times 40 = 10$. Total: $8 + 18 + 10 = 36$ students.

questions.stem: The functions $f$ and $g$ are defined by $f(x) = 2x - 3$ and $g(x) = x^2 + 1$. (a) Work out the value of $gf(2)$. (b) Work out the value of $ff(5)$.
